examples.en: We rented a small cottage near the lake for the weekend.
examples.zh: 我們週末在湖邊租了一間小屋。

examples.en: The old cottage has a garden full of roses.
examples.zh: 那間老小屋有個種滿玫瑰的花園。

examples.en: Grandma's cottage is only a short walk from the beach.
examples.zh: 奶奶的小屋離海灘只有一小段路。

examples.en: The city council will vote on the new bus route next week.
examples.zh: 市議會下週將就新的公車路線進行表決。

examples.en: Our school student council organizes a book fair every year.
examples.zh: 我們學校的學生會每年都舉辦書展。

examples.en: The council asked residents to share their opinions about the park.
examples.zh: 委員會請居民針對公園提出意見。

examples.en: Please pay for your drinks at the counter.
examples.zh: 請到櫃檯付飲料的錢。

examples.en: She put the groceries on the kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 她把雜貨放在廚房的檯面上。

examples.en: The machine has a counter that shows how many people enter.
examples.zh: 這台機器有個計數器，顯示進入的人數。

examples.en: The lawyer tried to counter every argument with clear facts.
examples.zh: 律師試著用明確的事實反駁每一項論點。

examples.en: The company hopes a new ad will counter the drop in sales.
examples.zh: 公司希望新廣告能抵銷銷售量的下滑。

examples.en: He countered that the plan would cost too much.
examples.zh: 他反駁說這個計畫花費太高。

examples.en: The courageous girl spoke up when she saw someone being treated unfairly.
examples.zh: 那個勇敢的女孩看到有人被不公平對待時挺身而出。

examples.en: It was courageous of him to admit his mistake in front of everyone.
examples.zh: 他在大家面前承認錯誤，真是有勇氣。

examples.en: The firefighters were courageous during the flood.
examples.zh: 消防員在水災期間表現得很勇敢。

examples.en: Please show courtesy to other passengers on the bus.
examples.zh: 請對公車上的其他乘客保持禮貌。

examples.en: The hotel gave us a free breakfast as a courtesy.
examples.zh: 飯店免費招待我們早餐作為一份好意。

examples.en: He thanked her for the courtesy of holding the door.
examples.zh: 他感謝她好心為他扶著門。

examples.en: He felt like a coward for running away from the problem.
examples.zh: 他覺得自己逃避問題像個懦夫。

examples.en: Don't be a coward; just tell the teacher the truth.
examples.zh: 別當膽小鬼，把實情告訴老師吧。

examples.en: Nobody wants to be called a coward in front of friends.
examples.zh: 沒有人想在朋友面前被叫做膽小鬼。

examples.en: There is a long crack in the bedroom wall.
examples.zh: 臥室牆上有一道長長的裂縫。

examples.en: Water leaked through a crack in the pipe.
examples.zh: 水從水管的裂縫漏了出來。

examples.en: We heard a loud crack of thunder just before the rain.
examples.zh: 下雨前，我們聽到一聲響亮的雷鳴。

examples.en: Be careful not to crack the eggs too hard.
examples.zh: 打蛋時小心別太用力敲開蛋殼。

examples.en: The ice began to crack under our feet.
examples.zh: 我們腳下的冰開始裂開。

examples.en: It took the team weeks to crack the code.
examples.zh: 團隊花了好幾週才破解這組密碼。

examples.en: Making paper lanterns is a popular craft for children.
examples.zh: 製作紙燈籠是很受孩子歡迎的手工藝。

examples.en: The village is famous for its traditional crafts.
examples.zh: 這個村莊以傳統工藝聞名。

examples.en: Writing a good story is a craft that takes years to learn.
examples.zh: 寫出好故事是一門要花好幾年學習的技藝。

examples.en: She crafted a small boat from a piece of wood.
examples.zh: 她用一塊木頭精心做了一艘小船。

examples.en: The teacher crafted a clear lesson plan for the class.
examples.zh: 老師為班上精心擬定了清楚的教案。

examples.en: The designer crafts each bag by hand.
examples.zh: 設計師親手製作每一個包包。

examples.en: The creation of this website took our team six months.
examples.zh: 這個網站的創造過程花了我們團隊六個月。

examples.en: Her latest creation is a dress made of recycled paper.
examples.zh: 她最新的作品是一件用回收紙做的洋裝。

examples.en: The artist was proud of his creation.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家為自己的創作感到驕傲。

senses.zh: 爬行；躡手躡腳地走；緩緩蔓延

examples.en: The baby began to creep across the floor toward her toy.
examples.zh: 寶寶開始朝著玩具爬過地板。

examples.en: I tried to creep into the room without waking my brother.
examples.zh: 我試著躡手躡腳走進房間，不吵醒我哥哥。

examples.en: Fog began to creep over the hills in the evening.
examples.zh: 傍晚時，霧氣開始緩緩漫過山丘。

examples.en: The film critic gave the movie four stars.
examples.zh: 這位影評給了這部電影四顆星。

examples.en: Critics praised the new restaurant for its fresh food.
examples.zh: 評論家稱讚這間新餐廳的食物新鮮。

examples.en: He is a harsh critic of his own work.
examples.zh: 他是自己作品的嚴厲批評者。

examples.en: Our teacher was critical of the way I wrote my essay.
examples.zh: 老師對我寫文章的方式頗有批評。

examples.en: Sleep is critical for students who are preparing for exams.
examples.zh: 對準備考試的學生來說，睡眠至關重要。

examples.en: The patient is in critical condition and needs care right away.
examples.zh: 這位病人病情危急，需要立刻照護。

examples.en: He accepted the criticism and promised to do better.
examples.zh: 他接受了批評，並承諾會做得更好。

examples.en: The new policy received a lot of criticism online.
examples.zh: 新政策在網路上受到許多批評。

examples.en: Good teachers give criticism in a kind way.
examples.zh: 好老師會用親切的方式給予批評。

examples.en: Please don't criticize others without knowing the whole story.
examples.zh: 在不了解整個來龍去脈前，請不要批評別人。

examples.en: The newspaper criticized the mayor for ignoring the traffic problem.
examples.zh: 報紙批評市長忽視交通問題。

examples.en: My coach never criticizes us in front of the team.
examples.zh: 教練從不在全隊面前批評我們。

examples.en: Animal cruelty is against the law in many countries.
examples.zh: 虐待動物在許多國家是違法的。

examples.en: She was shocked by the cruelty of the comments.
examples.zh: 她被這些留言的殘忍嚇到了。

examples.en: The story teaches children to stand against cruelty.
examples.zh: 這個故事教導孩子反對殘忍的行為。

examples.en: Crush the garlic before you add it to the pan.
examples.zh: 把大蒜壓碎後再放進鍋裡。

examples.en: Don't put heavy books on the box or you will crush it.
examples.zh: 別把重書放在盒子上，否則會把它壓壞。

examples.en: He crushed the empty can and threw it in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 他把空罐壓扁，丟進回收桶。

examples.en: She has a crush on a boy in her class.
examples.zh: 她暗戀班上的一個男生。

examples.en: Having a crush can make you feel nervous and happy at once.
examples.zh: 有暗戀的對象會讓你同時感到緊張又開心。

examples.en: His first crush was his English teacher.
examples.zh: 他第一個迷戀的對象是英文老師。

examples.en: The speaker waited for a cue before starting the music.
examples.zh: 講者等到有提示才開始播放音樂。

examples.en: Her yawn was a cue that it was time to leave.
examples.zh: 她打哈欠是暗示該離開了。

examples.en: Actors learn to follow every cue from the director.
examples.zh: 演員學著跟隨導演的每個提示。

examples.en: The cunning fox found a way into the chicken house.
examples.zh: 那隻狡猾的狐狸找到了進入雞舍的路。

examples.en: He made a cunning plan to win the game.
examples.zh: 他想出一個機靈的計畫來贏得比賽。

examples.en: The shop owner was too cunning to be fooled.
examples.zh: 這位店主太精明了，不會被騙。

examples.en: Curiosity led the boy to open the old box.
examples.zh: 好奇心促使那個男孩打開了舊箱子。

examples.en: She read the sign out of curiosity.
examples.zh: 她出於好奇讀了那個告示。

examples.en: Children are full of curiosity about the world.
examples.zh: 孩子對世界充滿好奇心。

examples.en: She likes to curl her hair before going out.
examples.zh: 她出門前喜歡把頭髮弄捲。

examples.en: The cat curled up on the sofa and fell asleep.
examples.zh: 貓咪蜷縮在沙發上睡著了。

examples.en: Smoke curled up from the chimney.
examples.zh: 煙從煙囪盤旋而上。

examples.en: The baby has soft curls on her head.
examples.zh: 這個小寶寶的頭上有柔軟的捲髮。

examples.en: He combed a curl of hair away from his face.
examples.zh: 他把一綹捲髮從臉上撥開。

examples.en: A curl of smoke rose from the campfire.
examples.zh: 一縷捲曲的煙從營火升起。

examples.en: In the story, a curse turned the prince into a frog.
examples.zh: 故事裡，一道詛咒把王子變成青蛙。

examples.en: The villagers believed the old house carried a curse.
examples.zh: 村民相信那棟老房子帶有詛咒。

examples.en: The kind wizard finally broke the curse.
examples.zh: 善良的巫師終於解除了詛咒。

examples.en: He cursed when he dropped his phone in the sink.
examples.zh: 他把手機掉進水槽時咒罵了一聲。

examples.en: In the tale, the witch cursed the village with endless rain.
examples.zh: 故事裡，女巫詛咒村子下個不停的雨。

examples.en: Don't curse at the referee; it is not polite.
examples.zh: 別對裁判咒罵，這樣不禮貌。

examples.en: She put a cushion behind her back on the sofa.
examples.zh: 她在沙發上把一個靠墊放在背後。

examples.en: The kids sat on cushions on the floor.
examples.zh: 孩子們坐在地板的坐墊上。

examples.en: This chair needs a softer cushion.
examples.zh: 這張椅子需要更軟的坐墊。

examples.en: A thick mat will cushion your fall in gym class.
examples.zh: 厚墊子能在體育課時緩衝你的跌落。

examples.en: Savings can cushion the impact of losing a job.
examples.zh: 存款能減輕失業帶來的衝擊。

examples.en: Foam cushions the camera inside the box.
examples.zh: 泡棉為盒內的相機提供緩衝。

examples.en: The towel is still damp, so don't put it away.
examples.zh: 毛巾還是濕的，先別收起來。

examples.en: It was a cold, damp morning in the mountains.
examples.zh: 那是山裡一個又冷又潮濕的早晨。

examples.en: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
examples.zh: 用一塊微濕的布擦桌子。

examples.en: The deadline for the report is next Friday.
examples.zh: 這份報告的截止日期是下週五。

examples.en: We worked late to meet the deadline.
examples.zh: 我們加班趕上了最後期限。

examples.en: Please send me an email if you need to extend the deadline.
examples.zh: 如果需要延長期限，請寄電子郵件給我。

examples.en: The principal declared that school would end early on Friday.
examples.zh: 校長宣布週五提早放學。

examples.en: Please declare any fruit or meat at customs.
examples.zh: 請在海關申報任何水果或肉類。

examples.en: The mayor declared the festival open.
examples.zh: 市長宣布慶典開始。

examples.en: We put up decorations in the classroom for the party.
examples.zh: 我們為了派對在教室裡佈置了裝飾品。

examples.en: The living room needs more decoration.
examples.zh: 客廳需要多一點裝飾。

examples.en: Red lanterns are a popular decoration during the Lunar New Year.
examples.zh: 紅燈籠是農曆新年期間很受歡迎的裝飾。

examples.en: Our school team defeated the other school in the final.
examples.zh: 我們校隊在決賽中擊敗了另一所學校。

examples.en: She defeated her fear of speaking in public.
examples.zh: 她戰勝了對公開演講的恐懼。

examples.en: The chess club hopes to defeat last year's champion.
examples.zh: 西洋棋社希望擊敗去年的冠軍。

examples.en: The team accepted its defeat with a smile.
examples.zh: 球隊面帶微笑接受了失敗。

examples.en: Defeat taught him to practice harder.
examples.zh: 失敗教會他要更努力練習。

examples.en: After three defeats in a row, the coach changed the plan.
examples.zh: 連續三次敗北後，教練改變了策略。

examples.en: The goalkeeper's job is to defend the goal.
examples.zh: 守門員的工作是防守球門。

examples.en: She defended her opinion with clear examples.
examples.zh: 她用清楚的例子為自己的意見辯護。

examples.en: Many people work to defend the rights of children.
examples.zh: 許多人努力捍衛兒童的權利。

examples.en: Our team's defense was strong in the second half.
examples.zh: 我們隊的防守在下半場很強。

examples.en: Good locks are a simple defense against theft.
examples.zh: 好鎖是防範竊盜的簡單防禦方式。

examples.en: The lawyer presented a clear defense in court.
examples.zh: 律師在法庭上提出了清楚的辯護。

senses.zh: 防守的；戒備的；防禦性的

examples.en: He became defensive when we asked about his grade.
examples.zh: 當我們問起他的成績時，他變得很戒備。

examples.en: The coach practiced defensive plays with the team.
examples.zh: 教練和球隊練習防守戰術。

examples.en: Defensive driving can help prevent accidents.
examples.zh: 防禦性駕駛有助於預防事故。

examples.en: We need a definite answer by Friday.
examples.zh: 我們週五前需要一個明確的答覆。

examples.en: There is a definite improvement in your writing.
examples.zh: 你的寫作有明顯的進步。

examples.en: Nothing is definite yet, so please wait.
examples.zh: 目前還沒有任何事確定，請稍候。

examples.en: Please handle the delicate glass cups with care.
examples.zh: 請小心處理這些易碎的玻璃杯。

examples.en: She wore a delicate silver necklace.
examples.zh: 她戴著一條精緻的銀項鍊。

examples.en: Talking about money with friends can be a delicate matter.
examples.zh: 和朋友談錢可能是個微妙的問題。

examples.en: The children screamed with delight when they saw the snow.
examples.zh: 孩子們看到雪，開心地尖叫起來。

examples.en: Reading in the garden is one of her simple delights.
examples.zh: 在花園裡看書是她簡單的樂事之一。

examples.en: To my delight, the exam was easier than I expected.
examples.zh: 讓我高興的是，考試比我預期的簡單。

examples.en: The magic show delighted the young audience.
examples.zh: 魔術表演讓年輕的觀眾非常開心。

examples.en: Her cooking never fails to delight our guests.
examples.zh: 她做的菜總是能讓客人們開心。

examples.en: The gift will surely delight your grandmother.
examples.zh: 這份禮物一定會讓你奶奶很高興。

senses.zh: 令人愉快的；討人喜歡的

examples.en: We had a delightful evening with our neighbors.
examples.zh: 我們和鄰居度過了一個愉快的夜晚。

examples.en: What a delightful surprise to see you here!
examples.zh: 在這裡見到你，真是個令人開心的驚喜！

examples.en: The hotel serves a delightful breakfast on the terrace.
examples.zh: 這間飯店在露台供應令人愉快的早餐。

examples.en: There is a high demand for fresh fruit in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天對新鮮水果的需求很高。

examples.en: The workers made a demand for shorter hours.
examples.zh: 員工們提出縮短工時的要求。

examples.en: Parents' demands can sometimes feel like too much pressure.
examples.zh: 父母的要求有時會讓人覺得壓力太大。

examples.en: The customer demanded a refund for the broken toy.
examples.zh: 顧客要求為壞掉的玩具退款。

examples.en: This job demands patience and careful work.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要耐心與細心。

examples.en: The teacher demanded that everyone stay quiet.
examples.zh: 老師要求大家保持安靜。

examples.en: The chef will demonstrate how to make dumplings.
examples.zh: 主廚將示範如何包水餃。

examples.en: The test results demonstrate that the new method works.
examples.zh: 測驗結果證明這個新方法有效。

examples.en: Students can demonstrate their skills in the talent show.
examples.zh: 學生可以在才藝表演中展現他們的技能。

examples.en: The teacher gave a demonstration of the science experiment.
examples.zh: 老師示範了這個科學實驗。

examples.en: The product demonstration starts at two o'clock.
examples.zh: 產品展示會在兩點開始。

examples.en: His smile was a demonstration of how happy he felt.
examples.zh: 他的笑容顯示出他有多開心。

examples.en: A dense fog covered the highway this morning.
examples.zh: 今早濃霧籠罩了公路。

examples.en: Tokyo is a dense city with many tall buildings.
examples.zh: 東京是個人口稠密、高樓林立的城市。

examples.en: The dense forest blocked most of the sunlight.
examples.zh: 茂密的森林擋住了大部分陽光。

examples.en: The train departs from platform three at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 火車九點從三號月台出發。

examples.en: Passengers should depart the bus through the rear door.
examples.zh: 乘客應從後門下公車離開。

examples.en: We plan to depart for Tokyo early tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們打算明天一早出發前往東京。

examples.en: Our flight's departure was delayed by an hour.
examples.zh: 我們班機的出發時間延後了一小時。

examples.en: Please check the departure time on your ticket.
examples.zh: 請確認機票上的出發時間。

examples.en: His sudden departure surprised everyone at the office.
examples.zh: 他突然離開讓辦公室的每個人都很驚訝。

examples.en: Young children are dependent on their parents.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子依賴他們的父母。

examples.en: Our picnic is dependent on the weather.
examples.zh: 我們的野餐要視天氣而定。

examples.en: Many small shops are dependent on tourists.
examples.zh: 許多小店依賴觀光客。

examples.en: Depression can make simple tasks feel very hard.
examples.zh: 憂鬱會讓簡單的事情變得很困難。

examples.en: Talking to a counselor can help with depression.
examples.zh: 和輔導老師談談可以幫助改善憂鬱。

examples.en: The country suffered a long economic depression in the 1930s.
examples.zh: 這個國家在 1930 年代經歷了長期的經濟蕭條。

examples.en: You deserve a rest after working so hard.
examples.zh: 你工作這麼努力，應該好好休息。

examples.en: Every child deserves a safe place to learn.
examples.zh: 每個孩子都值得擁有安全的學習環境。

examples.en: The team deserved to win after all that practice.
examples.zh: 經過那麼多練習，這支隊伍值得獲勝。

examples.en: The lost hiker was desperate for water.
examples.zh: 迷路的登山客迫切需要水。

examples.en: They made a desperate attempt to catch the last train.
examples.zh: 他們拚命想趕上最後一班火車。

examples.en: She felt desperate when she couldn't find her passport.
examples.zh: 找不到護照時，她感到絕望。

examples.en: We went to the park despite the rain.
examples.zh: 儘管下雨，我們還是去了公園。

examples.en: Despite his age, grandpa climbs the stairs every morning.
examples.zh: 儘管年紀大了，爺爺每天早上仍爬樓梯。

examples.en: She passed the exam despite being nervous.
examples.zh: 儘管很緊張，她還是通過了考試。

examples.en: The storm caused great destruction in the small town.
examples.zh: 暴風雨在小鎮造成嚴重的破壞。

examples.en: The destruction of forests harms many animals.
examples.zh: 森林遭到破壞，傷害了許多動物。

examples.en: Recycling helps reduce the destruction of natural resources.
examples.zh: 回收有助於減少對天然資源的破壞。

examples.en: The detective carefully looked for clues in the library.
examples.zh: 偵探在圖書館裡仔細尋找線索。

examples.en: A famous detective visited our school to talk about his job.
examples.zh: 一位著名的偵探來到我們學校談他的工作。

examples.en: She wants to be a detective when she grows up.
examples.zh: 她長大後想當偵探。

examples.en: Her determination helped her finish the marathon.
examples.zh: 她的決心幫助她跑完了馬拉松。

examples.en: He showed great determination to learn English.
examples.zh: 他展現出學好英文的強烈決心。

examples.en: The determination of the exact cost will take another week.
examples.zh: 確切費用的確定還需要一週。

examples.en: Please turn off all electronic devices during the exam.
examples.zh: 考試期間請關閉所有電子裝置。

examples.en: This small device can measure your heart rate.
examples.zh: 這個小裝置可以測量你的心率。

examples.en: A smoke alarm is a safety device every home should have.
examples.zh: 煙霧警報器是每個家庭都該有的安全設備。

examples.en: The team devised a plan to save energy at school.
examples.zh: 團隊想出了一個在學校節約能源的計畫。

examples.en: She devised a simple game to teach the children numbers.
examples.zh: 她設計了一個簡單的遊戲來教孩子數字。

examples.en: We must devise a better way to share the work.
examples.zh: 我們必須想出更好的分工方式。
